summary: BioMar plans to open a new aquaculture feed manufacturing plant in Tasmania, expanding its production capacity in the Asia-Pacific region. The facility represents the company's continued investment in aquafeed production infrastructure to serve growing demand from salmon and other aquaculture producers in Australia and neighboring markets.
title: BioMar to open new aquafeed plant in Tasmania
title_en: BioMar to open new aquafeed plant in Tasmania

summary: BioMar CEO Carlos Diaz announces that the company's strategic initiatives for 2020 will surprise the market. The statement indicates forward momentum and confidence in the company's planned business moves for the year ahead.
title: BioMar CEO Carlos Diaz: This year's strategic initiatives 'will surprise the market'
title_en: BioMar CEO Carlos Diaz: This year's strategic initiatives 'will surprise the market'
